acceptanceCriteria: An intent file that adds or changes requiresPool or requiredRoles on an adoptable record is adopted through a composed REFINE whose post record carries the file's value, or the spec states the ADOPT_UNSUPPORTED_FIELD refusal as the contract.
No adopt path drops a file-only optional key while reporting the file adopted.
Focused tests in internal/tasks/mutation cover add, change and remove for both keys.
body: Context: Go 1.27.1, Darwin arm64, 2026-10-04, branch claude/502-escalations-record-key (issue 502 record-key slice) from origin/main cd70ba0a. composeAdopt (internal/tasks/mutation/adopt.go) maps differing fields onto REFINE, PRIORITIZE, SET_DEPENDENCIES, SET_GATES, SET_EFFECTS and holds, but has no case for requiresPool or requiredRoles, although the REFINE payload admits both (mutation.go refine keys). Before the 502 slice, differingFields and adoptCovered iterated only the canonical record's keys, so an intent file that ADDED requiresPool/requiredRoles to a record lacking them was reported adopted with the key silently dropped; a file that changed an existing value was marked Present with no value composed. The 502 slice iterates the union of keys, so such files are now refused ADOPT_UNSUPPORTED_FIELD (TestIssue502_AdoptRefusesUncomposedAddedKey) instead of silently dropped. Expected: ADOPT_FILE composes a REFINE carrying requiresPool/requiredRoles (adding, changing, and if REFINE supports it, removing), or the refusal is documented as the contract. Actual: refusal (after the 502 slice) / silent drop (before).

title: ADOPT_FILE cannot compose requiresPool or requiredRoles edits although REFINE accepts both
